result.summary: Grade E (36/100): AI agents can get in; an agent cannot really read the page and has almost nothing to act on.

top_fixes.how_to_fix: +8 points: put the main content in the HTML sent by the server (server-side rendering or static pages).
+8 points: publish an OpenAPI description and announce it (<link rel="service-desc">, /.well-known/api-catalog or llms.txt).
+8 points: offer an MCP server and announce it (/.well-known/mcp.json or llms.txt) so agents can act directly.

criteria: Page delivered in 158 ms (8 points under 300 ms, 6 under 800 ms, 3 under 2 s).
No robots.txt (allowed, but agents get no guidance).

AI search and assistant bots allowed

About 26 words in the HTML itself (8 points from 300 words, 6 from 150, 3 from 40).

+2 points: label every form field (<label for> or aria-label); placeholders are not labels.
No contact found on the page.
+4 points: link a contact page, or show an e-mail or phone.

trust.verification_method: Deterministic visit (no AI model): up to 6 requests as BOTERNITY-AgentCheck/1.0, robots.txt respected, no JavaScript run; graded with the published scoring.
limitations: One visit from one location; a site can answer other agents, IP addresses or browsers differently.
Content that needs JavaScript is not seen, on purpose: many agents do not run it.
